title: 🏆 Application Overview
description: High-level KPIs for the International Football Statistics app — page views, API performance, web vitals, and user activity at a glance.

queries.sql: select count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='page_view'
select count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='api_call'
select avg(duration_ms) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='api_call'
select count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='error' or status >= 400
select histogram(_timestamp) as zo_sql_key, count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='page_view' group by zo_sql_key order by zo_sql_key
select page, count(*) as views, count(distinct trace_id) as sessions from "web_events" where event_type='page_view' group by page order by views desc

panels.title: API Calls Over Time by Endpoint

queries.sql: select histogram(_timestamp) as zo_sql_key, api_endpoint, count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='api_call' group by zo_sql_key, api_endpoint order by zo_sql_key

select histogram(_timestamp) as zo_sql_key, approx_percentile_cont(duration_ms, 0.5) as p50, approx_percentile_cont(duration_ms, 0.95) as p95, approx_percentile_cont(duration_ms, 0.99) as p99 from "web_events" where event_type='api_call' group by zo_sql_key order by zo_sql_key
select histogram(_timestamp) as zo_sql_key, action, count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='user_action' group by zo_sql_key, action order by zo_sql_key
select event_type, count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" group by event_type order by zo_sql_num desc
select count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='trace' and trace_action='start'
select (select count(*) from "web_events" where event_type='trace' and trace_action='start') - (select count(*) from "web_events" where event_type='trace' and trace_action='end') as zo_sql_num
select histogram(_timestamp) as zo_sql_key, trace_action, count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='trace' group by zo_sql_key, trace_action order by zo_sql_key
